```yaml
name: Validate OpenAPI Specs
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi-edge.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi-hyperloop.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/envd.yaml'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi-edge.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/openapi-hyperloop.yml'
      - 'packages/envd/spec/envd.yaml'

jobs:
  validate-openapi:
    name: Validate OpenAPI Spec
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        spec-file:
          [
            'packages/envd/spec/openapi.yml',
            'packages/envd/spec/openapi-edge.yml',
            'packages/envd/spec/openapi-hyperloop.yml',
            'packages/envd/spec/envd.yaml'
          ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install Redocly CLI
        run: npm install -g @redocly/cli

      - name: Validate OpenAPI Spec
        run: |
          redocly lint ${{ matrix.spec-file }}
```
